content.short: Hardware wallet that splits your seed across cards so there is no single backup to lose.
content.description: The Cypherock X1 removes the paper seed phrase. Private keys are split with Shamir secret sharing across the device and a set of NFC cards, so losing or leaking any one piece does not expose the wallet. It also offers non-custodial crypto inheritance. Manufactured in India, it has been audited by Keylabs, the firm that found flaws in Ledger and Trezor devices, and its firmware is open source.
content.meta: Cypherock X1 splits your keys across cards instead of one seed phrase, with open-source firmware and crypto inheritance.
